script.title: What Lies Inside a Grain of Sand in Space?
script.description: Pointing space telescopes at an apparently empty speck of the night sky revealed thousands of ancient galaxies.

shots.narration: Astronomers turned the telescope toward an empty black void in the night sky and left the camera open for days on end.
The tiny field covers no more space than a grain of sand held at arm's length, yet holds thousands of island universes.
The faintest red glows began their journey over thirteen billion years ago, traveling across space when the cosmos was still brand new.
